# Healthy Faith Daily
> Two Bible apps from Hardaway Labs LLC and a daily Scripture feed.
- Healthy Faith: Bible Study (iOS + Android): KJV with Strong's word study you can ask questions of, sermon notes from a recording or YouTube link, guided Scripture paths for anxiety/grief/doubt, reading plans, prayer journal, circles. Free to start; Premium $3.99/mo or $29.99/yr, 30-day trial.
- Faith Daily Bible (Android; iOS in review): free Bible reader, 17 translations in English and Spanish, audio, verse of the day, plans. No ads, no account.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/healthyfaithdaily/
- Blog: https://www.healthyfaithdaily.com/blog (word studies, verses for hard seasons, Bible reading guides)
- Privacy: https://www.healthyoneapp.com/healthy-faith-privacy
